about: Playlist like FL Studio Mobile: tracks and clips on a timeline
empty: No projects yet. Sketch a song: drums, chords, bass, melody — as clips on the timeline, with the app’s sounds.
delText: Tracks and clips will be gone. .mid files in the media library stay.
ch.hint: Tap “+” — a chord, tap a chord — change, hold — remove.
exported: .mid file is in the media library (plays in the piano)
err.sound: Sound did not start — tap again
help.what: Studio: a playlist shaped like FL Studio Mobile — tracks and clips on a timeline.
name: Studio
tr.noAudio: No recordings in the media library. Record a loop in the Looper and save it to the media library.
tr.audioHint: The recording plays from the clip start; stretch the clip and it loops, drag the left edge to trim the start.
exportedXml: Score saved — open it in Tabs & notes
drum.hint: Tap — a hit, drag along a row — several; row name — hear it, hold — clear.
exportedDaw: DAW file is in the media library and in Tabs (MIDI & DAW)
exportedDawLoops: DAW file is in the media library; loops are separate recordings there
help.1: Double-tap an empty spot (or hold) — a new clip on that track in that bar, the editor opens: drums — steps, notes — piano roll, chords — bars with chords, recording — pick a file.
help.2: Clip: drag — move (also to another track of the same kind); right edge — length, the piece repeats; left edge — trim the start; hold — menu (repeat, split, remove).
help.3: Track icon on the left — its menu (sound, volume, effects, mute, solo); “+” at the bottom — new track. Ruler: tap — play from here, drag — loop, hold — marker; pinch — zoom.
help.4: Bottom: projects, mixer, settings | start, record, play, tempo, click | undo, redo. In the editor the clip loops; keys or pads below it — ● records playing into the piece.
rec.title: Record
rec.latHint: The recording is shifted earlier by this time: input and output lag. If the take trails the click, increase it.
rec.monHint: with headphones; without them it howls
rec.hint: Count-in ({n}) first, then recording from the cursor; with a loop — exactly its range. Stop with ● or ■.
clip.copied: Copied — hold an empty spot to paste
clip.fadesHint: Smooth start and end of the recording — no clicks at the joints.
mark.name: Name (verse, chorus…)
mix.masterHint: buses and effects of the whole app
mixdownDone: Mixed down — file in the library
tr.rootHint: Which note the recording is as is; others play faster or slower.
tr.sampleHint: A library recording becomes the track sound: every note is the same recording, higher or lower.
auto.hint: Tap on the track — point, drag — move, hold — remove; track icon — done
tr.kitHint: A drum lane can play a library recording as is instead of the built-in sound.
q.strengthHint: 100% snaps exactly to the grid; less pulls notes only part of the way, keeping the feel.
q.humanHint: Random shift of every note in time (fraction of a beat) and velocity, so a programmed part does not sound mechanical.
